methods_quotes.q: Discharge diagnoses of visits to the student health center were reviewed to identify episodes of conjunctivitis.
A case of confirmed pneumococcal conjunctivitis was defined as a diagnosis of conjunctivitis with S. pneumoniae isolated from eye secretions.
Of eye specimens cultured from 189 students, 81 (42.9%) grew bacteria identified as S. pneumoniae by optochin sensitivity and bile solubility tests.
